title: The Taxidermist's Gilded Peacock
logline: An infamous jewel thief reinvented as a luxury orbital taxidermist is commissioned to restore an eccentric baroness's mechanical peacock automaton, hiding that the bird's gilded tail was secretly stuffed with stolen diamond microchips during its last exhibition.

roles.description: A former jewel thief who established an elite mechanical restoration studio; neurotic, meticulous, and desperate for social respectability.
An imperious orbital heiress who treats her heirloom clockwork peacock as a family member and demands perfection.
A suspicious port customs auditor trailing a ring of luxury microchip smugglers into the high-orbit suites.
An opulent zero-g workshop filled with lacquered glass display cases and gilded restoration tools.
A rotating glass ballroom where station aristocracy display antique mechanical curios during seasonal galas.

public_situation: High society arrives at {role:noble_gala_rotunda} to view the grand re-unveiling of a priceless century-old clockwork peacock following historical restoration.
private_truth: The peacock's hollow bronze tail plumes are packed with five thousand synthetic quantum microchips stolen from an orbital lab during the bird's transit.

beats.public_change: Private couriers deliver the mechanical peacock under armed guard to {role:taxidermy_atelier_berth} for final polishing.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to collect specialized gold-leaf restoration foil from a jeweler's vault before the gala opening.
missions.private_fact: While buffing the tail feathers, he discovered the smuggler's stash of microchips and knows his criminal past makes him the prime suspect.

beats.public_change: {role:customs_investigator} arrives outside the atelier with thermal scanners, ordering all antique shipments held for inspection.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the atelier's ventilation conduits to verify whether uncertified silicon cooling signatures are venting from the workshop.
missions.private_fact: Her promotion hinges on arresting the notorious jewel thief who embarrassed her department a decade ago.

beats.public_change: Guests assemble in the grand rotunda as {role:eccentric_baroness} demands the peacock be delivered to the center stage for her toast.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to rush the mechanical peacock to the rotunda dais through a service hatch before customs agents breach his shop.
missions.private_fact: If the bird reaches the stage with the chips inside, he can quietly extract the gems after the party and secure his retirement.

player_choice.prompt: With the mechanical peacock on the rotunda dais and customs closing in, the pilot must decide whether to expose the smuggling, extract the chips for the thief, or let the gala proceed.

options.label: Expose the hidden microchips to the customs investigator to claim the state reward
Help the reformed taxidermist extract the chips cleanly to preserve his respectable career
Inform the baroness that her beloved heirloom was used as a smuggling vessel to extort her

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes the microchips to customs.
resolutions.summary: {role:customs_investigator} arrests {role:reformed_taxidermist}. The baroness faints in horror, while the artisan's fifteen years of honest rehabilitation are erased by prison iron.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot revealed thousands of stolen quantum microchips hidden inside a socialite's antique mechanical peacock.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot helps extract the chips quietly.
resolutions.summary: The peacock performs flawlessly to thunderous applause. {role:reformed_taxidermist} fences the chips through offshore brokers, securing his studio and leaving customs empty-handed.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a high-society artisan steal quantum microchips out from under a customs inspection.

resolutions.summary: {role:eccentric_baroness} pays an exorbitant payoff to keep police from seizing her heirloom. {role:reformed_taxidermist} receives a handsome cut, though both live in mutual distrust.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot extorted a wealthy baroness after discovering her beloved clockwork peacock was stuffed with stolen tech.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the delivery.
resolutions.summary: Customs agents breach the workshop with cutting torches, seizing the disassembled bird. The baroness sues the station while the taxidermist vanishes into the outer belts.

loose_threads.detail: The clockwork peacock's internal gears carry micro-serial stamps matching an offshore luxury watchmaker that burned down five years ago.
A private banking house placed an anonymous buy order for synthetic quantum processors moments after the peacock was booked for restoration.

radio_hooks: High society flock to noble gala for unveiling of fully restored mechanical peacock automaton.
Customs authority steps up baggage searches across luxury passenger docks, citing technology theft.
Artisans guild praises delicate restoration work of former criminal turned master taxidermist.

voice_direction.reformed_taxidermist: High-strung, fastidious, and speaks with exaggerated refinement that occasionally slips into crude dockside argot when panic strikes.
voice_direction.eccentric_baroness: Imperious, drawling, and speaks to working people as though they were slow children. Refuses to brook any delay.
voice_direction.customs_investigator: Cynical, relentless, and peppers speech with sarcastic bureaucratic courtesy. Clearly relishes cornering wealthy suspects.
